title: Motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='40' ry='4' fill='#1b2a3a'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='15' fill='#2b3f56'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='7' fill='#9fb8cc'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='3' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='15' fill='#2b3f56'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#7fd8ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='7' fill='#9fb8cc'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='72' r='3' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M12 66 Q26 50 40 66' fill='#e04a4a' stroke='#ff8a8a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- body / frame -->
  <path d='M30 62 L52 44 L64 46 L58 62 Z' fill='#e04a4a'/>

  <path d='M30 60 Q40 50 52 44 L50 40 Q38 44 26 54 Z' fill='#3a2b4d'/>

  <rect x='42' y='56' width='14' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='58' width='4' height='6' fill='#c4d4e2'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <path d='M56 64 L74 62' stroke='#c4d4e2' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- fork -->
  <path d='M64 46 L76 60' stroke='#c4d4e2' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <path d='M62 42 L70 38' stroke='#c4d4e2' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='37' r='2' fill='#ffd966'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='52' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
</svg>
